content.text:
I added a `chat` script to `package.json`:

```json
"chat": "agents tui http://localhost:8787/channels"
```

It uses `agents tui`, the terminal client for a Web Channel that comes with `agents` 0.27.0. I found it in `node_modules/agents/dist/cli.js`, which documents it as `agents tui <url> [--as <participant>] [--header <name=value>]...`. npm puts `node_modules/.bin` on the path when it runs scripts, so nothing new needs to be installed.

I haven't run it: that needs `npm run dev` running, and running `npx agents tui --help` needed approval, so I didn't. To use it, run `npm run dev` in one terminal and `npm run chat` in the other. The `--as` and `--header` flags aren't needed locally, because the dev setup in `src/index.js` makes everyone the same `dev` participant.
